title: Who’s Sorry Now: User Preferences Among Rote, Empathic, and Explanatory Apologies from LLM Chatbots
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this topic was outside the scope of its investigation into chatbot apology types and user preferences.

measurement_description: The paper did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus was on user preferences for different types of chatbot apologies (rote, empathic, explanatory) in response to three types of errors: factual mistakes, unfounded fabrications (hallucinations), and bias (specifically gender bias).
